exposure: Existing verified 1 MiB development range only; no acquisition, no held-out or full-corpus claim. Canterbury/Calgary/Artificial gate remains required before renewed full Silesia qualification.
hypothesis: An open idle pipe producer can obtain a complete compressed frame and reconstructed bytes before EOF with a 100ms flush, while the full stream restores exactly.
initial_state: fresh encoder and fresh archive-only decoder processes; no warmed model, input cache state uncontrolled
matched_control: Exact frozen 1MiB source; this is a streaming availability check, not comparative codec ranking.
mechanism: Pipe producer remains open until both complete first frame and fresh decoder bytes are observed; source remainder uses irregular chunks and an additional idle period.
promotion_criteria: Both output events must occur before source EOF; independent runner fresh uncix must match length and SHA. Complete archive integrity requires verified footer; wall timing is best-effort and includes encoding/OS/output delay.
resource_accounting: WaveScheduler aggregate cap is four physical cores, 12 GB RAM, 4 GB temporary storage, no swap. Every cell leases CPUs 16,17,18,19 and all CIX cells are dispatched serially; unrelated host background load is uncontrolled.
